correctness.rationale: The scope is exactly five complete MUBs in complex dimension four. The published classification reduces to one explicit two-qubit Pauli model. The stand-alone checker constructs all 20 projectors, proves pairwise unbiasedness by rational traces, enumerates all 15 commuting Pauli triples and their 60 joint eigenrays, then verifies all 1140 triples of measurement rays are independent and that every one of 4845 four-ray determinants vanishes iff its indices belong to one of forty six-zero stabilizer configurations (600 cases). These are exhaustive finite Gaussian-integer identities, not sampling. Consequently any vector with >=4 zero outcomes lies on the unique common orthogonal ray of one dependent four-selection and must have exactly six zeros. Generic subspace arguments realize 0,1,2 zeros; a basis ray realizes 3. This proves exactly 0,1,2,3,6 zeros and support totals 20,19,18,17,14, with precisely 40 minimizers. All arithmetic values stay far below 2^53, ensuring Gaussian-integer components are exactly represented by built-in complex arithmetic. All computations were run from VERIFY.py as included.

value.rationale: The aggregate support spectrum is a natural exact invariant of a complete complementary quantum measurement; prior recent research resolves its odd-prime counterpart while the first even-prime-power case has different Pauli geometry. The forbidden 15 and 16 levels are a genuine structural gap, not a routine enlargement of an extremal constant. The exact 600/4845 rank-incidence classification and all forty equality rays give a complete, reusable finite measurement constraint result. The claim stays finite-dimensional and does not rely on speculative downstream applications.
